sentence: With the network off after one online visit, PHQ-9 item 9 "several days" halts the flow at the crisis screen
Reload lands on the crisis screen while the block is on
Back lands on the crisis screen while the block is on
A direct visit to /options (and /consent and /ticket) lands on the crisis screen while the block is on
Each crisis number is visible as text and tappable
"Call now" alone leaves the block on
"I'm safe right now — continue" releases the block and matching runs
After reconnecting, the queued crisis event arrives once, with no item answers
Demo persona 1 steps 2-5 pass with the stated scores, a stored earlier check-in standing in for step 3's clock move
An unverified item shows its label
No matching input reaches the network, asserted by request interception
Every person screen loads with no console error and its favicon answers 200
